description: Infrabel's telecom infrastructure is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Quarterly evolution of Infrabel's telecom infrastructure in kilometres of optical fibre and number of interconnected transmission nodes. This network allows Infrabel's applications and staff to communicate with each other in complete safety. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are IT, Telecom. The portal shows 44 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
